column5: - `TP/terminal_module.rs:99-101`: a folded-constant dependency with no candidate skips association checks. `:1109-1124`: binary search over data whose sortedness is not checked here. `:495`: callback `&|_, _| true` (meaning not read).

- `TP/types_and_values.rs:2180-2182, 1899-1901`: `ElementViewWrite`'s element path is left out of two enumerations, so a runtime index there would not be remapped or listed. `TP/control_flow.rs:2360-2365`: per-case structural arguments missing from `storage_uses`. `:472`: a future call-like variant is silently not an invocation.
- `TP/lib.rs:891, 904-910` and `TP/ownership.rs:644-704`: default and `Unresolved` handles whose rejection lives elsewhere.

- Finite families: `TT/calls_and_control_flow.rs:759-772`: a later `requires` fact that is not finite or not an expression is ignored once a finite disjunction is found; the family then lists tuples the extra clause forbids.

- Ranking: `TT/evidence_and_inspection.rs:1911-1919`: if no expression in the root state matches the witness text, any expression in the program with that text is used; the termination check could run on the wrong expression (callers not read).

- Parameter naming: `TT/values.rs:4003`: a one-member name equal to the parameter's name counts as the parameter even when its symbol is another declaration, such as a shadowing local (four callers not read).

- Name fallbacks: `TT/operator_declarations.rs:3429-3448` with `:3752-3755, 3673` (same-spelled type from another declaration accepted as an operator operand); `TT/lib.rs:416-419` (same-named unrelated type substituted); `DTI:6148-6153, 6167-6171` (same-named data definition chosen when the symbol finds nothing); `TT/type_identity.rs:1997-2006`; `TT/type_system.rs:4648-4676` (user type spelled like a primitive gets primitive semantics; shadowing rule not traced); `TT/evidence_and_inspection.rs:21-24`; `TT/values.rs:95-99` (unresolved name spelled `7`).

- Operators: `TT/operator_declarations.rs:1998-2003` (a primitive operand matches any non-primitive expected parameter); `:2314-2316` (domain constraints compared by semantic id only); `:789-791` (valid target symbol returned with no visibility or arity check).
